name: spinner
need: Show a short wait in place, or a known share as a ring

--ds-spinner-size.description: a spinner at md, before the size step

--ds-spinner-determinate-size.description: `.ds-spinner--determinate` at md, before the size step

--ds-spinner-track.default: none (`--ink`: a faint ring of the text colour; `--determinate`: `--ds-accent`), `--ds-primary` (`--ink`: `currentColor`)
--ds-spinner-track.description: spinner: the track behind the arc, the arc

--ds-spinner-color.default: none (`--ink`: a faint ring of the text colour; `--determinate`: `--ds-accent`), `--ds-primary` (`--ink`: `currentColor`)
--ds-spinner-color.description: spinner: the track behind the arc, the arc

--ds-spinner-determinate-width.default: a tenth of its size (4px at md)
